q: Which best describes Hermes Agent's position in the open-source landscape?
options: A developer framework for coding agents, for engineers only
A closed chat app with no customisation
An agent you own and run yourself, between a chat app and a dev tool
A fork of a commercial enterprise platform
explanation: Hermes sits between a chat app (easy, closed) and a developer framework (powerful, code-heavy): an agent you own and run, no coding required.

q: Which of these is one of the reasons Hermes Agent stands out?
options: It only runs on expensive enterprise servers
It self-improves by saving skills and remembering you across sessions
It cannot connect to any messaging app
It requires you to pay per message in naira only
explanation: A built-in learning loop writes reusable skills from your experience and remembers you, so the agent gets better at your work over time.

q: Where does Hermes keep your secrets?
options: In your own environment — your machine or your VPS
On the model provider's servers only
In a public notebook on GitHub
explanation: Because it runs on your own machine or server, secrets stay in your environment. The code is open source so its behavior is auditable.

q: Which research organisation is behind Hermes Agent?
explanation: Hermes Agent comes from Nous Research, the lab behind the Hermes open-source models.
